description: Keyboard shortcuts are used to perform tasks quickly and efficiently in MS Office applications like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. This is a highly important topic under Computer Knowledge for competitive examinations.

sections.title: General MS Office Shortcuts
sections.description: These are basic keyboard shortcuts that function similarly across almost all Microsoft Office applications.

key_associations.extra_info: Saves the selected text or object to the clipboard without removing it from the original location.
Inserts the copied or cut item from the clipboard into the current document.
Removes the selected item from its original position and saves it to the clipboard.
Cancels or reverses the last performed action.
Reapplies the action that was previously undone.
Secures and saves the current document.
Opens the print dialog box to configure and execute printing.

sections.title: MS Word Specific Shortcuts
sections.description: Important shortcut keys primarily used for text formatting and editing within MS Word.

key_associations.extra_info: Makes the selected text thick and bold.
Slants the selected text to the right (italicizes it).
Draws a continuous line directly under the selected text.
Inserts a clickable web link or file link into the selected text.
Aligns the text evenly along both the left and right margins of the page.
Aligns the selected text to the exact center of the page.

sections.title: MS Excel Specific Shortcuts
sections.description: Crucial shortcuts for managing spreadsheets, cells, rows, and columns in MS Excel.

key_associations.extra_info: Allows direct editing of data within the currently active cell.
Selects the entire horizontal row of the active cell.
Selects the entire vertical column of the active cell.
Starts a new line of text within the boundaries of the same cell.
Instantly inserts today's date into the active cell.

sections.title: MS PowerPoint Specific Shortcuts
sections.description: Shortcuts designed to control and manage presentations and slide shows effectively.

key_associations.extra_info: Begins the presentation slide show from the very first slide.
Begins the presentation slide show from the currently selected slide.
Adds a new, blank slide immediately after the active slide in the presentation.
Creates an exact duplicate copy of the currently selected slide.
Exits the currently running slide show and returns to the normal view.

sections.title: Important Function Keys and Facts
sections.description: Specific uses of function keys in MS Office programs and other frequently tested facts.

key_associations.extra_info: Opens the standard Help window in almost all MS Office and Windows applications.
Initiates a comprehensive spell check and grammar check within the document.
Opens the 'Save As' dialog box, allowing you to save the file with a new name, format, or location.

important_facts.fact: In MS Word, the shortcut 'Ctrl + N' is used to open a completely New Document, whereas 'Ctrl + O' is used to open an Existing Document.
In MS Excel, the 'Ctrl + Page Down' and 'Ctrl + Page Up' keys are exclusively used to rapidly navigate back and forth between different worksheet tabs.
